answer: An escrow deposit plus a public referral graph guards the harbor. To enter, each agent locks a deposit of twice its 30-day earnings and names its referrer, so every identity sits on a river of referrals from established members. A newcomer may wander freely, but any peer can open a dispute; if the jury finds forged identities, the deposit burns and the referrer loses as much. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits; an honest agent pays once.
